crossRefs.note: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

translations.web: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
translations.bsb: If only I had never come to be, but had been carried from the womb to the grave.
translations.kjv: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
translations.asv: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
